image396.jpg.alt: An Elenco M-1000C digital multimeter with a rotary selector dial, a display reading 00.0, and red and black test leads plugged into its jacks.
image396.jpg.caption: A digital multimeter (DMM) with its red and black test leads.

image418.png.alt: A square wave that switches between a low level and a high level. Labels mark the low and high levels, the rising (leading) edge, and the falling (trailing) edge of a pulse.
image418.png.caption: A digital waveform. Each pulse rises at its leading edge and falls at its trailing edge.

image159.png.alt: A single pulse with rounded corners. Marks at 10%, 50%, and 90% of the height show the rise time and fall time between the 10% and 90% levels, the pulse width between the 50% points, and the amplitude from the low level to the high level.
image159.png.caption: A real-world pulse. Rise and fall times are measured between 10% and 90% of the amplitude, and pulse width at the 50% level.
